unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #13 (github.com/sriram1983007-dev/sra-riskgate/issues/13): "A feeless settlement leg: stablecoin settlement with no issuer to depeg". Argued in its own risk-gate terms: USDC depeg checks in both directions -> on Nano the unit is the coin, no issuer to hold a peg so the check becomes a constant; self-transfer impossible (address is the whole wallet); the block is the evidence the model policy review reads. Named a Nano payload to sra_riskgate.check_payment beside x402/AgentKit. Carried nano-invoice + extract.paypercall.dev. Verified open under dhyabi2.
